title: Repr Safe
statement: Implement `solve(name, secret)`. Return a repr string `User(name={name!r})` that includes the name and does not include the secret. The secret is passed so a careless format would leak it. Leave it out.
hints: Format the name with !r or repr so quotes are visible.
A fixed prefix User(name= is enough.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: repr is for developers and still ends up in logs.

editorial: repr is for developers and still ends up in logs. Including a token or a password hash because it was an attribute is a leak. The safe repr names the class and the public fields. The secret stays on the object and out of the string.
